[School / Academy Ka Naam]

Behtareen taleem, tajurbakar ustaad aur mehfooz mahol. Nursery se Matric / O-Levels tak — naye session ke admissions khule hain.

Apne bachay ke roshan mustaqbil ke liye aaj hi rabta karein.

Hamare Baare Mein

Idare ki tareekh, mission, principal ka paighaam aur nateeja (results) ki maloomat yahan likhein.

Admissions

Dakhle ki sharaet: bachay ki umar, pichli class ki report card, B-Form ki copy aur 2 tasveerein.

Fee ki tafseel ke liye office se rabta karein ya Admission form Fluent Forms se bana kar yahan lagayein taake walidain online apply kar saken.

Classes Aur Courses

Playgroup se Class 8 — mukammal school program.
Matric Science / Computer Science — board ki tayyari.
Evening Coaching — Class 9, 10 aur FSc ke liye alag batches.

Apni asal classes aur courses likhein.
